text:
Scheme: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) (Agriculture, Central)
Section: Benefits and Financial Assistance
Details:
Rs 6,000 per year per eligible farmer family, paid in 3 instalments of Rs 2,000 every 4 months by Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
Official Link: https://pmkisan.gov.in

Scheme: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) (Agriculture, Central)
Section: Eligibility Criteria
Details:
Landholding farmer families (husband, wife and minor children) with cultivable land in their name as per land records.
Official Link: https://pmkisan.gov.in

Scheme: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) (Agriculture, Central)
Section: Exclusions and Non-Eligibility
Details:
Institutional landholders; present/former holders of constitutional posts, ministers, MPs, MLAs; serving or retired officers (except MTS/Class IV/Group D); pensioners with Rs 10,000+ per month; income tax payers in the last assessment year; registered professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs, architects).
Official Link: https://pmkisan.gov.in

Scheme: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) (Agriculture, Central)
Section: Required Documents
Details:
Aadhaar, land ownership records, bank account (Aadhaar-seeded), mobile number, eKYC.
Official Link: https://pmkisan.gov.in
